appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Adjust UI theme and font display

ai.label: Show AI panel by default
ai.description: Auto-expand AI chat panel when opening the editor

statusBar.label: Status bar
statusBar.description: Show word count, cursor position at the bottom

hiddenFiles.label: Show hidden files
hiddenFiles.description: Show dotfiles and hidden folders in the file tree

wiki.label: Wiki panel
wiki.description: Show Wiki entry in the sidebar

clips.label: Clips panel
clips.description: Show web-clips entry in the sidebar

analyze.label: Project analysis panel
analyze.description: Show project-analysis entry in the sidebar

daily.label: Daily notes panel
daily.description: Show calendar and daily notes entry in the sidebar (disabling also disables ⌘D)

tray.label: Show tray icon
tray.description: Show the app icon in the system tray; click it for the same quick-action menu as the pet right-click menu

excludePatterns.label: Filter files/folders
excludePatterns.description: Matched files/folders are hidden in the file tree. Supports * and ? wildcards.
excludePatterns.prompt: Enter a filter pattern (supports * and ? wildcards)

editor.title: Editor
editor.description: Configure editor behavior and display options

showLineNumbers.label: Show line numbers
showLineNumbers.description: Show line numbers on the left of the editor

linkOpenMode.label: Link open mode
linkOpenMode.description: Default behavior when clicking a link

dailyNotes.title: Daily Notes
dailyNotes.description: Configure storage directory and date format for daily notes

shortcuts.title: Shortcuts
shortcuts.description: Click a shortcut field to re-record; press a new key combo to change it

editor.conflictHint: No key captured — this combo may be taken by the app menu or OS (⌘Q / ⌘H / ⌘M / ⌘W / ⌘⇧P)

cli.title: CLI Tools
cli.description: Configure AI CLI tools for smart document editing
cli.adapterHint: Each adapter has its own executable path; which adapter a chat session uses is selected in the AI Panel / pet Chat — this tab only configures paths.

claude.description: Anthropic's official CLI; supports conversational editing and multi-tool calls

pi.description: Pi coding agent (@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent); read/bash/edit/write tools, RPC multi-turn sessions

cliPath.label: CLI path
cliPath.hint: Path or command name of the CLI executable; click "Detect" to auto-find

settingsFile.title: Open this adapter's config file in the Quill editor
settingsFile.missingHint: The settings file hasn't been created yet (the CLI usually creates it on first run).
settingsFile.createTitle: Write a minimal valid template and open it

usage.title: Usage
usage.description: AI tools edit documents by calling a local CLI (e.g. Claude Code). Make sure the corresponding CLI is installed. Edits are shown as diffs and applied after confirmation.

scriptRuntime.title: Script Runtimes
scriptRuntime.description: Run code blocks in markdown preview
scriptRuntime.usageHint: Click Run on a ```bash / ```js / ```python block in markdown preview to execute it. Output is written back as a > Result: blockquote.

models.title: Model Services
models.description: Configure LLM providers and models for chat / agent conversations

chat.title: Chat mode
chat.description: Multi-turn chat via rig direct LLM (no CLI, no tool/file access). ask/agent still use the CLI above.

models.refetchAllHint: Configure at least one provider first
models.backendNotReady: Backend not wired yet — use another provider

baseUrl.label: API URL
baseUrl.anthropicHint: Leave empty for official Anthropic; Anthropic-compatible endpoints
baseUrl.openaiCompatibleHint: Required for Ollama / vLLM / LM Studio etc.; /v1 is appended automatically if missing.

thinkingBudget.label: Thinking budget (tokens)
thinkingBudget.hint: Applied to reasoning-capable models; non-reasoning models ignore this.

picker.searchPlaceholder: Search by model ID or name

askAI.label: Ask AI
askAI.suggestedHint: Click a tag to add to the toggles below, then Save

localFirst.title: Local-first
localFirst.description: Data is stored on your device

plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.description: Install, approve, enable or uninstall third-party plugins (microkernel + plugin SDK)

uninstallConfirm.title: Uninstall plugin
uninstallConfirm.message: Uninstall this plugin? Its folder, approval, and registered contributions will be removed.

consent.title: Approve trusted plugin
consent.warning: Trusted plugins run in the main process and have full host capabilities (read/write the vault, invoke Tauri commands, access all React state). Approval equals full trust — only approve plugins from sources you trust.

voice.title: Voice input
voice.description: Click 🎤 in the AI chat or press the global hotkey to start recording; speech is transcribed, polished, and inserted into the focused input (works across apps).
voice.windowsUnsupported: . Voice input is not supported on this platform
voice.windowsUnsupportedBanner: Voice input is not supported on this platform. macOS uses Apple Speech; Windows uses WinRT SpeechRecognition.

permission.denied: Still not granted — click to retry

accessibility.title: Accessibility permission
accessibility.desc: Cross-app text insertion requires accessibility permission. Click the button to trigger the system prompt; restart the app after granting (TCC caches the decision at process start).

microphone.title: Microphone permission
microphone.desc: Recording requires microphone permission. Click the button to trigger the system prompt; if previously denied, allow Quill under System Settings → Privacy & Security → Microphone, then retry.

speech.title: Speech recognition permission
speech.desc: Apple Speech transcription requires speech recognition permission. Click the button to trigger the system prompt; if previously denied, allow Quill under System Settings → Privacy & Security → Speech Recognition, then retry.

polishPrompt.label: Polish prompt
polishPrompt.desc: Polish the raw transcript using the current AI config (see AI tools). Leave empty to skip polishing.

autoPolish.title: Auto polish
autoPolish.desc: After recording, automatically run the polish prompt on the transcript; disable to output raw transcript

autoPaste.title: Auto paste
autoPaste.desc: Automatically paste the recognized text at the cursor position; requires Accessibility permission

saveSource.title: Save voice source file
saveSource.desc: Save the raw recording (WAV) to a specified directory under the vault

sourceDir.label: Source directory
sourceDir.desc: Relative to the current vault root; saved file is <dir>/<timestamp>.wav

spokenLanguage.label: Recognition language
spokenLanguage.desc: Apple Speech routes recognition by language; pick "Simplified Chinese" for Chinese speech. The system default locale may not match the spoken language; specify explicitly to avoid empty transcripts.

globalHotkey.label: Voice hotkey
globalHotkey.desc: Leave empty to disable; when set, hold the hotkey to start recording, release to finish and insert into the focused input (cross-app). Esc clears.

templates.title: File Templates
templates.description: Configure the default template content for new files by extension. Variables: {{title}}, {{filename}}, {{date}}, {{ext}}

skills.title: Skills
skills.description: Configure AI skill templates; custom prompts control the format and quality of AI-generated content

capability.title: Capability binding
capability.desc: Assign a skill to each capability; Claude Code follows the corresponding skill's instructions to complete the task.

form.idHint: Slug format; lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens only
form.promptPlaceholder: Enter a prompt template; use {{variableName}} for variables...

skills.confirmReset: Reset to defaults? Unsaved changes will be lost.
skills.confirmDelete: Delete this skill? This cannot be undone.

pet.title: Pet
pet.description: Configure the desktop pet icon and display

showPet.title: Show pet
showPet.desc: Show the desktop pet window on screen (macOS)

icon.title: Icon
icon.desc: Use the built-in Quill icon, or upload a custom image

errors.desktopOnly: Desktop feature; please use in a Tauri environment
errors.unsupportedFormat: Only png / jpg / webp / svg formats are supported

opacity.title: Pet opacity
opacity.desc: Adjust the pet window's overall opacity (25% / 50% / 75% / 100%)

clickThrough.title: Click through
clickThrough.desc: When enabled, the pet window ignores pointer events and clicks pass through to apps behind it

api.title: External notify API
api.desc: Other apps can POST to localhost port {{port}} to trigger pet notifications

templates.title: Bubble style
templates.desc: Choose a bubble template. Four built-in presets, or upload custom HTML+CSS templates

previewSample.text: Preview: this is a sample notification
previewSample.title: Preview title

templates.missingFields: Missing required fields: id / name / html / css
templates.idCollision: Template id collides with built-in; auto-prefing user:

ai.title: AI Bubble Template Generator
ai.unconfigured: Configure chatProvider / chatModel / chatApiKey in AI settings first
ai.inputPlaceholder: Describe the bubble template you want, e.g., birthday reminder card
ai.imageNotSupported: Current model doesn't support image input — switch to a vision model or upload HTML instead
ai.htmlWrapPrefix: Adapt the following HTML into a BubbleTemplate (must pass DOMPurify, on* attrs stripped, no external resources):
ai.imageWrapPrefix: Generate a BubbleTemplate (html + css) that visually matches the attached image. Use the image's layout, colors, and text as the design reference.
ai.emptyResponse: AI returned no content. Please retry.

whitelist.title: External app whitelist
whitelist.desc: macOS apps named by {{launch.type}} in notifications must be listed here to be launchable

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Choose the form of desktop pet event notifications

form.title: Notification form
form.desc: Popover card anchors to the pet; corner toast stacks at a screen corner (passive, no focus steal)

cornerPlacement.title: Corner placement
cornerPlacement.desc: The screen corner where the toast stack attaches

cornerTtlMs.title: Notification TTL
cornerTtlMs.desc: Auto-dismisses at TTL; "never" requires manual close (applies to both popover card and corner toast)

csp.title: Security Policy (CSP)
csp.description: Control which external URLs the app may load

mode.label: External URL mode
mode.description: Choose whether the app may load resources from any website or only from your allow-list

urls.label: Allowed URLs
urls.description: Hostnames, full URLs or scheme sources (e.g. example.com, https://api.example.com, https:). Applied to scripts, styles, fonts, images, media, connections, workers and frames.
urls.empty: No URLs — only the built-in baseline applies
urls.invalid: Not a valid hostname / URL / scheme

preview.label: Effective policy
preview.description: The policy below takes effect after clicking Apply & Reload.

baseline.note: Tauri IPC, quill-plugin, asset, data: and blob: are always allowed and cannot be removed.

apply.note: Clicking Apply reloads the page — it flashes briefly. Newly added URLs and “Allow all URLs” only take effect after the reload.
